title: Connecticut Youth Employment Program
description: A state program that connects young people with paid jobs so they can earn money and build their resumes. You apply through the regional Workforce Development Board closest to where you live.

title: UConn Summer LEAD Program
who_text: High-achieving Connecticut residents entering their senior year of high school; first-generation students and students in Alliance School Districts are encouraged
description: A free, short stay on the UConn Storrs campus where you live in a residence hall, try sample classes, and learn how college admission and financial aid work.
